newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tonen to launch new desulphurisation unit.
newsitem.headline: Tonen to launch new desulphurisation unit.

text.p: Tonen Corp said on Thursday it will begin operating a new desulphurisation unit with a capacity of 25,000 barrels per day (bpd) at its Kawasaki refinery around mid-June.
A company spokesman said the unit, which cost about 40 billion yen, uses technology provided under licence by U.S. firm Hydrocarbon Research Inc (HRI).
The new facility makes it possible to refine residue and produce more middle distillates such as kerosene and gas oil, while simultaneously decreasing output of C fuel oil, Tonen said in a statement.
It said it will be able to increase middle distillate production by an annual 1.1 million kilolitres.
Tonen's Kawasaki refinery has a topper capacity of 240,000 bpd.
